fusions.name: Herd Nip
fusions.desc: A darting nip at one enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max +40%).

fusions.name: Warm Bodies Boil Over
fusions.desc: The swarm boils out around you and deals 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle in the Straw
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Barn-Fat Colony
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
